purpose: Derived bidirectional lookup index contract for the shared Hero-Soldier Relation Layer. Both indexes are disposable acceleration artifacts generated exclusively from the A-6 canonical relation set.

authority.rule: Neither index may add, remove, reinterpret or infer a relation. If an index disagrees with the canonical edge set, the index is stale or invalid and must be regenerated.

relationSetDescriptor.gitBlobSha: exact Git blob SHA of the canonical relation set used to build this index

commonRootShape.rule: The by-Hero and by-Soldier artifacts generated together must reference the exact same relation-set blob SHA.

byHeroContract.keyEncoding: Canonical heroId serialized as its base-10 JSON object key string with no prefix or padding.
byHeroContract.value: Array of canonical soldierId integers connected to that Hero by canonical edges.
byHeroContract.generation: For every edge (heroId, soldierId), append soldierId to byHeroId[String(heroId)].
byHeroContract.entryRule: Create keys only for heroId values present in canonical edges. Entity existence outside the edge set remains the responsibility of Hero Master.
byHeroContract.missingKeyMeaning: No canonical relation edge for that heroId in this relation-set snapshot; it does not by itself mean the Hero ID is invalid.

bySoldierContract.keyEncoding: Canonical soldierId serialized as its base-10 JSON object key string with no prefix or padding.
bySoldierContract.value: Array of canonical heroId integers connected to that Soldier by canonical edges.
bySoldierContract.generation: For every edge (heroId, soldierId), append heroId to bySoldierId[String(soldierId)].
bySoldierContract.entryRule: Create keys only for soldierId values present in canonical edges. Entity existence outside the edge set remains the responsibility of Soldier Master.
bySoldierContract.missingKeyMeaning: No canonical relation edge for that soldierId in this relation-set snapshot; it does not by itself mean the Soldier ID is invalid.

generationAlgorithm: Read only the validated A-6 canonical relation-set edges as semantic input.
Initialize independent empty byHeroId and bySoldierId maps.
For each canonical edge exactly once, append edge.soldierId to the edge.heroId key and append edge.heroId to the edge.soldierId key.
Do not consult provenance to decide whether the pair belongs in either index; edge existence already represents the final A-5 semantic union.
Do not generate either index from the other index.
Sort keys and value arrays deterministically, then validate parity against the canonical edge set.
Write both artifacts with the same relation-set blob SHA.

byHero.keyCount: number of distinct heroId keys in byHeroId
byHero.relationCount: sum of all soldierIds array lengths

bySoldier.keyCount: number of distinct soldierId keys in bySoldierId
bySoldier.relationCount: sum of all heroIds array lengths

summaryContract.semanticRule: Index summaries are derived diagnostics only and must not be used to infer relations.

parityInvariants: byHero.relationCount must equal canonical relation-set summary.edgeCount.
bySoldier.relationCount must equal canonical relation-set summary.edgeCount.
byHero.keyCount must equal the count of distinct heroId values present in canonical edges.
bySoldier.keyCount must equal the count of distinct soldierId values present in canonical edges.
Every canonical edge (h, s) must appear exactly once as s in byHeroId[h].
Every canonical edge (h, s) must appear exactly once as h in bySoldierId[s].
No pair absent from canonical edges may appear in either index.
No value array may contain duplicates.
The set reconstructed from byHeroId must exactly equal the canonical edge pair set.
The set reconstructed from bySoldierId must exactly equal the canonical edge pair set.
The pair sets reconstructed independently from both indexes must be exactly equal to one another.
provenanceAccessRule: Consumers that need evidence for a relation must resolve the exact (heroId, soldierId) pair back to the canonical A-6 edge. Index files intentionally do not duplicate provenance.
failurePolicy: Do not silently deduplicate duplicate values produced from malformed canonical edges; canonical pair duplication must already fail upstream validation.
Do not repair a missing pair by reading the opposite index.
Do not repair an index from Hero/Soldier names or ConfigData directly.
If the two index artifacts reference different relation-set blob SHAs, treat the pair as invalid/stale.
If any parity invariant fails, discard/regenerate the derived indexes; never modify canonical edges to make an index pass.

baselineReference.reason: These are regression references from the frozen pre-migration 3-12 snapshot. Current/future game data may legitimately change.

ownershipBoundary.heroPipeline: May consume byHeroId but must not independently calculate Hero-Soldier membership.
ownershipBoundary.soldierPipeline: May consume bySoldierId but must not independently calculate Soldier-Hero membership.
ownershipBoundary.relationLayer: Owns canonical edges and generation of both indexes.
ownershipBoundary.pageLayer: May join IDs from an index to Hero/Soldier Masters for presentation metadata only.

completion: A-7 is complete when both lookup directions are formally defined as deterministic, lossless, disposable projections of the exact same canonical relation-set edge blob, with bidirectional parity required before downstream consumption.
